verdict.rationale: The evidence shows in-product Payroll AI that spots timesheet inconsistencies, plus a UI step to review and approve payroll before paychecks go out. Neither is an API an external agent could call to run a payroll preview and surface anomalies. The only payroll-related developer evidence covers workers' comp code requests and a sandbox company, and no OpenAPI spec was found. These are adjacent features and developer building blocks, so they earn no credit toward this story.
